description: This file contains implementation functions related to SHA-1 collision detection and integration with Git, including initialization, finalization, and update functions for SHA-1 contexts with special handling for collision attacks.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCInit(SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Initializes the SHA-1 context and sets safe hash to 0, conditionally compiled if DC_SHA1_EXTERNAL is defined.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCFinal(unsigned char hash[20],SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA-1 hash computation, checks for collision attacks, and terminates the program with an error message if a collision is suspected.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX * ctx,const void * vdata,unsigned long len)
methods.description: Updates the SHA-1 context with data, adjusting for the system's integer size limitations.

ctags.name: git_SHA1DCUpdate
ctags.pattern: /^void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX *ctx, const void *vdata, unsigned long len)$/
